name: CC Snapshot
description: Source obligation schedule CC utilisation on 30 June 2026 only. Do not apply June limits to historical months. Bank/account coverage is incomplete, and differing source balances are preserved for reconciliation. Kotak and Union CC limits not supplied in schedule.
mExpression: let R=Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("",BinaryEncoding.Base64),Compression.GZip)), T=Table.FromRows(R,{"As Of","Account","Sanctioned","Schedule Outstanding","Schedule Utilisation","Statement Drawn","Statement Less Schedule","Interpretation"}), X=Table.TransformColumnTypes(T,{{"As Of", type text},{"Account", type text},{"Sanctioned", type number},{"Schedule Outstanding", type number},{"Schedule Utilisation", type number},{"Statement Drawn", type number},{"Statement Less Schedule", type number},{"Interpretation", type text}}) in X
